notes.title: "A DAY IN SPACE" coming out on Steam on August 23
notes.notes:
[b]"A Day In Space" is coming out on August 23![/b]

"A Day In Space", the first commercial release by Fabiulous Games, is coming out on Steam on August 23!
Wishlist the game now to not miss the discount at launch!
The game will cost 5.99$, but the price at launch will only be 2.99$ thanks to a 40% discount!

The [u]HYPE[/u] is [u]REAL[/u]

Your Dev,
